scripts.dev:api: npm run build:contracts && npm run start:dev -w @checkout/api
scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build -w @checkout/api && npm run build -w @checkout/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:contracts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:cov: npm run build:contracts && npm run test:cov --workspaces --if-present
